question: give district wise pp increase between 2021 and 2023 only Gaya and Nalanda
gold_sql: WITH rates AS (SELECT district, year, 100.0 * anc4_completed / pregnancies_registered AS rate FROM anc_visits WHERE district IN ('Gaya', 'Nalanda') AND year IN (2021, 2023)) SELECT district, ROUND(MAX(CASE WHEN year = 2023 THEN rate END) - MAX(CASE WHEN year = 2021 THEN rate END), 1) AS change_pp FROM rates GROUP BY district ORDER BY district
sql_duckdb: SELECT T1.district, (T2.anc4_completed - T3.anc4_completed) * 100.0 / NULLIF(T3.anc4_completed, 0) AS percentage_increase FROM anc_visits AS T1 INNER JOIN (SELECT district, year, anc4_completed FROM anc_visits WHERE district IN ('Gaya', 'Nalanda') AND year = 2023) AS T2 ON T1.district = T2.district AND T1.year = 2023 INNER JOIN (SELECT district, year, anc4_completed FROM anc_visits WHERE district IN ('Gaya', 'Nalanda') AND year = 2021) AS T3 ON T1.district = T3.district AND T1.year = 2021
